business_problem: Broad, generic marketing and weak profile resolution kept the CFL from personalizing fan engagement or maximizing sponsorship and conversion value across its clubs.
solution_summary: The Canadian Football League built a league-wide customer 360 marketing stack around Snowflake, RudderStack, and Braze so fragmented fan behavior could be turned into actionable profiles. RudderStack collects events across web, apps, streaming, gaming, and other touchpoints, while Snowflake centralizes more than 120 attributes for each fan in a single table that clubs across the league can access. Braze then activates those profiles through email, web, SMS, and push campaigns, letting teams personalize offers for in-market supporters, visiting-team fans, bettors, and event attendees without hand-built engineering work. Shared events, cloned canvases, and common data points let the CFL scale one orchestration pattern across all nine clubs rather than maintain separate implementations. Braze geolocation and signals from CFL Game Zone and CFL+ extend the same architecture into blended digital and in-person experiences, improving retention and sponsor value while minimizing opt-outs.

solution_components.name: RudderStack
solution_components.role: Collects and routes fan-behavior events from digital properties into the league's central customer model.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Stores league-wide fan profiles and performance data as the shared customer 360 foundation.

solution_components.name: Braze
solution_components.role: Activates audience segments across email, web, SMS, push, and location-aware fan engagement campaigns.

data_flow: Fan behavior from websites, apps, CFL Game Zone, streaming, and other channels is captured in RudderStack and centralized in Snowflake as customer 360 profiles. Braze consumes those segments to deliver targeted omnichannel messages, and campaign results flow back into the league's measurement and sponsorship workflows.
business_outcome: The CFL achieved up to 9x better conversion on personalized content, grew its marketable audience 215% over two years, improved sponsor asset value, and reduced opt-outs while creating a more scalable league-wide marketing model.
